messages:
julia: Quick lunchtime poll — who wants what today? Sushi 🍣 / Tacos 🌮 / Salad 🥗. Reply with the emoji or say your choice. Also bonus: nominate someone for the 'emoji award' (funniest reaction) this week.
sam: Sushi for me! 🍣
mika: Tacos please 🙋‍♀️
diego: Salad, trying to be healthy lol 🥗
anya: Sushi but I can split tacos if someone orders extra :P
ops-bot: Poll recorded so far: Sushi 2, Tacos 1, Salad 1
julia: Also — nominate someone for emoji award? I nominate @mika for the :fire: reaction to the infra alert yesterday
mika: aww thanks :blush: but I vote @diego for constantly reacting with :chef: to any food thread
diego: I only used :chef: once, I'm a simple man :smile:
sam: can't pick between @julia and @mika, both great reels :thumbsup:
julia: OK quick majority vote: react with :one: for mika, :two: for diego, :three: for julia
(people react)
ops-bot: Emoji award tally: :one: 2 votes (mika), :two: 1 vote (diego), :three: 1 vote (julia). Winner: mika :tada:
ops-bot: Final lunch tally: Sushi 2 (julia, sam), Tacos 1 (mika), Salad 1 (diego).
julia: Nice — I'll place the sushi order + add extra tacos to cover mika. ETA pickup 12:30. Anyone want soy on the side?
sam: yes pls soy for me
mika: no soy thanks, but extra spicy salsa if possible 🌶️
diego: salad dressing on the side for me, thx
anya: thanks julia! :raised_hands:
mika: woo thanks team :tada:
diego: next time I'll bribe with cookies :cookie:
